sections.voiceover: On Wednesday, the 86-year-old actor died at his Los Angeles home. Did joining the Royal Shakespeare Company in 1966 launch his iconic career?
sections.visual_cue: Historical theatre exterior shot transitioning to Los Angeles skyline.

sections.voiceover: He didn't stop with television, playing iconic roles like Professor X in X-Men.
sections.visual_cue: Archival footage of royal investiture ceremony.
b_roll: Queen Elizabeth II knighthood ceremony still

sections.voiceover: Queen Elizabeth II knighted Sir Patrick Stewart in 2010 for services to drama. Sir Patrick Stewart shaped drama from the Royal Shakespeare Company to Star Trek.
sections.visual_cue: Side by side photo of Sir Patrick Stewart and Ian McKellen.

sections.voiceover: Remember his unforgettable performances across stage and screen.
